data_integrity.join: date + race number + >= max(5,ncars-1) independent same-car rider name prefixes; reject ambiguous candidates
data_integrity.line: exact numeric line_position strings and contiguous position indexes, no inferred lineups
data_integrity.round: exact published round_name; meeting_day from venue_info
data_integrity.payout: optional independently matched three-car winning order plus payout, mismatch tracked
data_integrity.privacy: only audit metrics and ≤12 illustrative race metadata retained, no third-party raw archive republished

limitations: 2025-11-16 to 2026-08-17 still has no public verified full lineup source
Source records may not represent precisely what was known at betting cutoff
No first-day feature may be inferred from race number
Current engine 12-month ROI cannot be calculated from incomplete source
